other_conditions: Applicable to defaulting consumers in the categories of LIG (Low‑Income Group), Domestic, Agriculture, Small Commercial, and LTP (Motive Power)
Consumers with accumulated arrears up to ₹20,000 as of 31‑03‑2008 are eligible
Installations must be temporarily or permanently disconnected as of 31‑03‑2008 for non‑payment of outstanding arrears
Consumers whose cases have been referred to the Revenue Recovery Court (R.R.C.) are also eligible
Scheme is valid for three months from the date of notification
benefits_summary: All delayed payment charges, including 18% interest, are waived and consumers pay only the principal amount in a lump‑sum payment.
documents_required: Demand Draft or Pay Order of ₹100/- in favour of the Chief Electrical Engineer
